opennyai_summary.decision:
1. Further to the order dated 19.12.2025, this application has been filed by Mr. Pushpender Singh for impleadment as a petitioner, as he is also an accused in the subject FIR bearing No. 86/2020 dated 27.02.2020, registered at Police Station Prem Nagar, District Rohini, New Delhi, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
For the reasons stated therein, the application is allowed, and the amended memo of parties is taken on record.
3. The application stands disposed of.
